summary: Completed testing of FREK v2 Dashboard CC2026 Monitor features - 15/15 backend tests passed, all frontend components verified. Dashboard endpoints, admin X-Admin-Key protection, RGPD deletion, and real-time polling all working correctly.

GET /api/v1/dashboard/cc2026 - returns luciole_funnel with all 5 stages
GET /api/v1/dashboard/cc2026 - with X-Admin-Key returns admin_mode=true and recent_activity
GET /api/v1/dashboard/cc2026/live - returns lightweight live metrics (total, active, percentage, last_activity)

context_for_next_testing_agent: FREK v2 Dashboard fully implemented. New endpoints: GET /api/v1/dashboard/cc2026 (consolidated metrics), GET /api/v1/dashboard/cc2026/live (lightweight polling). Admin endpoints now require X-Admin-Key header (string value from SECRET_KEY in .env). RGPD deletion at DELETE /api/v1/admin/identity/{id}/gdpr removes identity + all stages. Frontend at /dashboard uses framer-motion, fetches data from dashboard endpoints, polls live endpoint every 5s. 14 existing CC2026 identities in test data.
